tool.title: 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix
tool.excerpt: The 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix (officially known as the Formula 1 Gran Premio de la Ciudad de México 2026) was a Formula One motor race that was held on 1 November 2026 at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez in Mexico City, Mexico. It was the nineteenth round of the 2026 Formula One World Championship. Lewis Hamilton (Ferrari) took his first pole position since the 2023 Hungarian Grand Prix, and his first pole position with the team. Kimi Antonelli clinched his first Formula One World Drivers' Championship after achieving third. Antonelli became the youngest Drivers' Champion at the age of 20 years, two months and seven days, beating the previous record holder Sebastian Vettel, the first Italian Drivers' Champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953, and Mercedes' first Drivers' Championship since Hamilton secured his seventh title in 2020. Ahead of him, Max Verstappen (Red Bull) won the race and Hamilton finished second in an eventful race. The Grand Prix also saw Ryo Hirakawa make his Formula One Grand Prix debut with Haas, where he benefitted from drivers ahead of him receiving penalties to score his first Formula One point. == Background == The event was held at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez in Mexico City for the 26th time in the circuit's history, across the weekend of 30 October – 1 November, having previously held twenty editions of the Mexican Grand Prix. The Grand Prix was the ninteenth round of the 2026 Formula One World Championship and the sixth held under the name of the Mexico City Grand Prix, having previously been titled the Mexican Grand Prix. === Championship standings before the race === Going into the weekend, Kimi Antonelli led the Drivers' Championship with 365 points, 123 points ahead of teammate George Russell in second and 124 ahead of Lewis Hamilton in third. Mercedes, with 607 points, led the Constructors' Championship from Ferrari, who were second with 474 points, and Red Bull and McLaren, who both tied on 355 points. ==== Championship permutations ==== Going into the race, there were 125 points available across the five remaining scheduled rounds.
